IncidentBot: [ALERT] realtime-p99-regression detector fired for service=redwood-inference-api · p99 latency > 1200ms over 5m · paging on-call
alice_sre: seeing the same in dashboards, p95 jumped to ~400ms, p99 ~1300ms around 17:02 UTC. streaming sessions show stalls.
ben_oncall: i'm on it, joining bridge in 2m. can someone grab customer impact? @carla_prod maybe? :phone:
carla_prod: quick check — top 3 tenants show increased error budgets used. No full outage reported but degraded for interactive chat (long tail). CS has 3 tickets mentioning slow responses.
dana_infra: infra blips? nodes show normal CPU on gpus, but one pod group for stream-workers-az2 shows sustained high recv queue length.
eric_reliability: looks like kv-cache hit rate dropped around the same time (dash shows cold cache churn). Could be a rollout or cache eviction storm.
ben_oncall: can someone check recent deploys? `deploy-bot`?
ops_bot: deploy-bot: deploy completed: service=redwood-inference-api @ 2026-03-15T16:58:34Z by ci/cd (change-id: feat/kvcache-improve).
alice_sre: that lines up. rollback candidate. but let's validate with quick mitigation first: switch traffic to standby variant (kvcache-disabled) for the affected model family.
ben_oncall: initiating traffic shift to fallback model variant (canary->standby) for region us-west-2. Command: `infractl route traffic --service inference-api --model-family gpt-open --variant standby --percent 100 --region us-west-2`
dana_infra: running the command now, patching LB rules.
ops_bot: route-change: started patch; expected convergence ~30s.
carla_prod: i just notified the top 3 customers and provided temporary guidance: retry with backoff and report any hung streaming sessions.
eric_reliability: dashboards — after routing change: p95 dropped to 180ms, p99 falling to ~350ms within 90s. streaming stall count down from 47 -> 8.
ben_oncall: nice. keep a close eye for 10m window. i'll keep the channel open for postmortem notes.
alice_sre: note for postmortem: root suspicion = kv-cache rollout change in feat/kvcache-improve causing eviction and churn under steady-state requests. fallback variant disables that codepath. need logs from the rollout.
dana_infra: fetching deploy diffs and rollout logs: `ci artifacts show feat/kvcache-improve --since=2026-03-15T16:55Z`
ops_bot: logs: node/stream-worker-az2 - OOM? no. warnings: "cache_eviction_rate=0.73" and repeated "prefetch_miss spike" traces.
ben_oncall: any error spikes in application logs? `kubectl logs -l app=inference-api -c stream-worker --since=10m`
advice: use the snippet below to gather tail logs from the problematic pod group
```
kubectl get pods -l app=stream-worker -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running
kubectl logs -l app=stream-worker -c stream-worker --tail=200
```
eric_reliability: pulled raw tail logs, attaching key lines: "WARN prefetch miss 12x per sec" "KVCache eviction loop started" "retrying chunk fetch" — suggests cache thrash causing request-level stalls.
carla_prod: CS escalations — three enterprise customers asked for SLA credits; i've logged them and requested correlation IDs for the affected requests.
ben_oncall: mitigation status: traffic fully shifted back to standby variant, health checks green, p99 down under 400ms. leaving shift in place until rollout is reverted.
alice_sre: action items (short-term): 1) keep fallback in place 2) revert feat/kvcache-improve rollout 3) collect heap/profile and eviction traces from stream-worker pods 4) notify customers with timeline and ETA for full fix.
dana_infra: initiating rollout revert: `deploy-bot revert --change feat/kvcache-improve --to stable`
ops_bot: deploy-bot: revert started, expected duration ~6m.
eric_reliability: quick checks: dataset of recent traces shows increased tail latency correlated with cache miss ratio > 0.4 and with requests that hit prefix caches. collecting span ids for PM.
ben_oncall: is there any short-lived mitigation we can add that isn't full revert? maybe increase cache size or tune eviction threshold?
alice_sre: we tried increasing cache size in staging; in prod it would be risky without rollout plan. revert is safer and faster.
carla_prod: i'll draft customer-facing note with current status: mitigation applied, revert in progress, monitoring, targeted next update in 30m.
ops_bot: revert completed successfully at 17:08 UTC.
eric_reliability: post-revert metrics: p95 steady ~170ms, p99 ~320ms, streaming stalls back to baseline. KVCache eviction rate returning to expected <0.05.
ben_oncall: closing page for now but leaving channel open for postmortem writeup and timeline. if any regression in next 60m i'll repage. :thumbsup:
alice_sre: capturing timeline and evidence for postmortem. will include correlation graphs, deploy artifact, and a recommended safe rollout gating (gradual ramp + synthetic cache warmers + eviction alarms).
carla_prod: i've updated customers and created tickets for SLA credit review.
IncidentBot: [RESOLVED] realtime-p99-regression · mitigation applied and rollback confirmed · page closed
ben_oncall: thanks team. big takeaway: treat kv-cache rollout as high-risk for streaming workloads; update rollout playbook.
alice_sre: agreed — will file remediation PR for rollout checks and canary warmers.
carla_prod: closing this thread and moving to postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
